proposed_rules.trigger: A recurring end-of-page zone (rc2) with a CTA heading and a pipe-only link row, identical at the bottom of every page.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude from per-page block inventory; model as a global footer fragment/site-wide chrome, analogous to the confirmed knack-announcement-bar rule.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structure across every page examined in this batch.

proposed_rules.trigger: 'Join ... users' heading immediately followed by a 5xN grid near the top of a solution page.
proposed_rules.decision: Emit as one 'trust-badges' block, one row per badge/item. Rejected alternative: a generic unnamed logo/card grid.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs with identical shape across multiple solution pages in this batch.

proposed_rules.trigger: A [bg:color] panel next to a [bg:image] panel with zero captured text.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted extraction rather than treating as a pure decorative background. Rejected alternative: full-width-image-behind-text section mapping (no text was captured to overlay).
proposed_rules.rationale: minWidth capture likely collapsed responsive text normally accompanying the image panel; same pattern seen on C243 and C244.

proposed_rules.trigger: An empty 252px-tall zone with no text or children, appearing as the last content node before the global footer on a solution page.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude from block inventory as a decorative spacer/divider.
proposed_rules.rationale: Exact 252px height recurs identically on multiple solution pages (C243, C247).

notes: solution-7 template repeats the feature-cards pattern three times (two plain, one on color background) plus one under-rendered split-image panel; otherwise matches the standard solution-page skeleton.
